sessionStart.command:
echo `# <#` > /dev/null
launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.0-9/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$launcher" activate cursor; fi
printf '%s\n' '{"additional_context":"Ponytail hooks missing: run node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}'
exit #> > $null 2>&1
$launcher=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.0-9/launch.cmd'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf) { & $launcher activate cursor; if (-not $? -and -not $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 1 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output '{"additional_context":"Ponytail hooks missing: run node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}'
